guitar.modelsText: Gibson Les Paul / Fender Stratocaster / ES-335
guitar.evidence: Joe Bonamassa is famous for his large collection of vintage Gibsons (Les Pauls, ES-335s) and Fender Stratocasters; extremely well documented in guitar media.

tone.target: big blues-rock lead with wah and gritty crunch
tone.profile: big blues-rock lead with wah and gritty crunch
tone.summary: A gritty, mid-forward signal chain featuring a Boost pedal for attack, followed by a Wah effect, leading into the UK 45 amp model with a British cabinet, perfect for thick lead sustain and classic blues crunch.
corrections: drop generic fuzz unless truly nasal/buzzy

rig.name: Joe Bonamassa - The Ballad Of John Henry - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum.
Simulate the Tube Screamer/overdrive boost for articulate pick attack and mid-forward crunch.
blocks.gap: The Boost model is used to emulate a classic TS circuit, focusing on tightening the low end and boosting mids without excessive distortion.

alternatives.reason: Similar function but may have different voicing.

blocks.purpose: Provide the signature wah phrasing required for blues lead work.
Provide the necessary grit and sustain for lead lines without excessive modern gain.
blocks.gap: Using general Distortion model to achieve a classic, gritty crunch suitable for blues rock, avoiding overly fizzy or nasal tones.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the Marshall-style amp voicing for classic blues-rock tone and headroom.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound matching the Marshall voicing.
Add subtle delay repeats to enhance sustain and depth without sounding ambient.
blocks.gap: The 'corrections' noted keeping the delay subtle, so settings are kept low.

alternatives.reason: Might be too warm/vintage for this specific blues-rock grit.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle natural room ambience to glue the signal chain together.

improvements.summary: Enhance cabinet realism with a specific, gritty IR to better capture the vintage blues-rock tone.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage 4x12 British cab IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback/Greenwich)
proposals.reason: The current generic IR may lack the specific grit and vintage character needed for Joe Bonamassa's blues tone.
